requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization and maintain accurate attendance records across multiple classes.
The system shall implement robust auditing mechanisms for attendance reporting and data access.
The system shall store historical attendance data for a minimum of five academic years to support long-term analysis.
The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations when handling student attendance data.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records only after successful authentication.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms for data processing and resource optimization.
The system shall provide notifications of attendance status to students within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that carbon footprint notifications are anonymized to protect individual data privacy.
